text:
maya: Quick sync — Acme just escalated: tenant-level SSO + exportable analytics for GA. This is a big ask. Do we take into MVP or push to v1? timeline implications below.

quentin: I'm leaning v1. Rough dev estimate: ~6w for tenant SSO + full export. We could do a tiny "lite" SSO for MVP in ~1w (email-only flow). :thinking:

sarah: For launch criteria we need: security signoff, SSO e2e tests passing, analytics retention controls in place. If we defer, we must set clear fallback comms for Acme.

albert: Punting to v1 shifts GA ~3w. Current milestones if we keep scope: 
- sprint-12: feature freeze 2024-09-20
- sprint-13: QA & canary 2w
- GA target: 2024-10-18
If we split scope, we can keep GA but we need a strict "MVP-lite" definition.

maya: Proposal: ship "SSO-lite + analytics opt-in" in MVP; ship tenant SSO and full export in v1. That gives Acme incremental value without blowing the schedule. Thoughts? :thumbsup:

quentin: I can own MVP-lite scoping + PR for feature flag. Plan: prod flag + small UX to connect org email domains + backlog ticket for tenant mapping. I’ll aim to have a draft PR by EOD Wed.

quentin: config example I'll use in PR:
```
feature_flags:
  sso_tenant: off
  sso_lite: rollout(5pct)
  analytics_export: off
```

sarah: I'll add the launch criteria and the rollback triggers to the roadmap checklist. Quick note: add a metric for signups->SSO success rate and a regression alert for latency > 200ms on auth.

albert: Also adding: dependency list (infra + migrations). If we move full SSO to v1 we can reuse existing auth infra but need a small DB migration window. That’s the +3w.

deploy-bot: milestone updated — sprint-12 feature-freeze shifted +3w by @albert (reason: scope split for Acme).

maya: Good. Owner actions: @quentin scope-lite PR, @sarah update checklist + notify PMs, @albert schedule migration window. I'll loop in security/design for quick review.

quentin: ack, starting the PR.

sarah: will update doc and ping stakeholders.

maya: thanks — we'll reconvene if any blocker pops up.
